data.name: Type Shogun
data.detailed_description:
Type Shogun is a colorful educational typing adventure where keyboard practice becomes a battle to defend the Keyboard Kingdom.

Learn proper typing technique from the very beginning. Letters, numbers, words, symbols, and passages move across the screen. Type them before they reach your Shogun. Correct typing triggers sword attacks, while later challenges test your speed, accuracy, and focus.

Build keyboard confidence through play

Type Shogun helps players practice real keyboard skills in a more engaging way. Instead of staring at static drills, players learn by reacting, typing, improving, and progressing through a colorful shogun quest.

Save the Keyboard Kingdom

Begin with a guided tutorial, then progress through campaign battles that introduce new typing challenges step by step. Practice letters, capitalization, numbers, symbols, words, and passage-style typing as you fight toward the Dark Shogun's castle.

A unique keyboard guide overlay shows the key to press, while transparent hand and finger guidance helps players see which finger should reach each letter, number, or symbol. These visual learning tools help new typists build correct habits early by reinforcing home-row technique and finger-to-key memory as they play.

Parents can see the learning happen. As new typists follow the on-screen keyboard and transparent hand overlays, they are encouraged to press each key with the intended finger instead of hunting and pecking. From the first tutorial lesson, Type Shogun helps build the muscle memory behind proper home-row technique.

For new and experienced typists

Type Shogun is perfect for children and adults. Guided typing help, adjustable challenge settings, Sandbox practice, and WPM tests give beginners room to learn while giving stronger typists ways to practice speed, accuracy, and consistency.

Practice your way

Sandbox Mode lets you customize typing practice with adjustable speed, spawn timing, target types, and challenge settings. Make practice calmer, faster, simpler, or more intense depending on what you want to train.

Test your speed

WPM Mode includes timed typing tests, generated word streams, quotes, paragraphs, custom text practice, saved seeds, and local records for repeatable challenges.

  • Perfect for children and adults

  • Colorful typing adventure campaign

  • Beginner-friendly tutorial

  • Letters, numbers, words, symbols, and passages

  • On-screen keyboard guide

  • Transparent hand and finger guidance

  • Customizable challenges for first-time typists and experienced keyboard users

  • Sandbox Mode with adjustable speed, spawn rate, target types, lives, and FREEZE ability

  • WPM Mode with built-in passages, generated practice, custom text, and saved records

  • Built-in typing practice library

  • Custom text practice

  • Saved seeds and local records

  • Adjustable difficulty, text size, contrast, music, sound effects, and gameplay options

  • Keyboard-only option (no mouse required to play)

  • Single-player

  • Available on Windows and macOS

A keyboard-first adventure

Type Shogun is designed around typing. Use your keyboard to practice skills, defeat targets, and protect the kingdom.

Learn to type. Master the keyboard. Save the kingdom.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit
  • Processor: 64-bit dual-core processor
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 compatible integrated graphics or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 350 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio device
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Physical keyboard required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 13.0 or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon or Intel 64-bit processor
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible graphics
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Physical keyboard required.
